About this study

Editable, procedurally authored Blender geometry inspired by the Negev erosional landscape. Not an exact reconstruction or hand-sculpted work.

Model and poster are embedded locally. Nothing is minted, on-chain, signed or hosted. Proposed launch: 201 one-of-one Boxes, each with the same edition scarcity. Accessories are a later separate collection; certificates would be signed records, not independent NFTs.
